content: WIOA, MyCAA & Army CA IT Training | IT Expert System, IL top of page Skip to Main Content Empower Clients Through IT IT EXPERT SYSTEM, INC IT Training, Staffing and IT Services Provider 847 350 9034 | info@itexps.com Upcoming Training Book an Appointment WIOA Education Grant Programs for IT Training & Career Development in Schaumburg, IL Unlock Your Path to a High-Demand IT Career—With Funding Support ​ Unlock Your Path to a High-Demand IT Career with WIOA-Funded Training Programs ​ At IT Expert System, we help individuals start or advance their IT careers through federally funded training programs including WIOA, MyCAA, ITA, TAA, and Army COOL. These programs make IT training more affordable or fully funded for those who qualify. ​ You may be eligible if you are unemployed, underemployed, receiving public assistance (such as SNAP), or part of the military community, including veterans, active-duty service members, and spouses. ​ Even if you are simply looking to upgrade your skills, earn industry-recognized certifications, or transition into a better-paying IT career, these programs are designed to support your goals. ​ Our mission is to help you gain in-demand IT skills, achieve career growth, and connect with real job opportunities through structured training and expert guidance. ​ Click on the program that fits your situation to learn more and schedule a quick consultation with our team.
